title: Provision and Wreck
author: Coral Sterling
blurb: Ada Okafor, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
